Message.Name: Options Add Order Message
Message.Description: Published when a new visible order has been received and added to the book.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to this order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The order price. Use with the Price Scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The order quantity in contracts

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order (Buy/Sell).

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: The market participant's firm ID (always space). ' ' - (space or 0x20)

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: CustIndicator
Field.Description: Capacity of the order.

Message.Name: Options Modify Order Message
Message.Description: Sent when the price or volume of an order is changed due to an event other than a cancel-replace, or full or partial execution.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to the order to be modified

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new order price. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The new order quantity in contracts.

Field.Name: Position Change
Field.Description: Defaulted to '0'. If the price didn't change, order keeps position. If price changed, order loses position.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order (Buy/Sell).

Field.Name: CustIndicator
Field.Description: Capacity of the order.

Message.Name: Options Delete Order Message
Message.Description: Published when an order is taken off of the book for any reason except for full execution.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to the existing order to be deleted

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Options Order Execution Message
Message.Description: Sent when an order is partially or fully executed.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to the partially or fully executed order.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the matching engine to this execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of this trade. Use the Price Scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The executed quantity in contracts.

Field.Name: PrintableFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether trade is included in total volume.

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: TradeCond1
Field.Description: Settlement related conditions.

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Options Replace Order Message
Message.Description: Published when a cancel/replace order is received. The resting order is replaced with a new order containing the same outright or complex series, side and attribution, a new Order ID, and the price and size specified.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to the existing order to be replaced

Field.Name: NewOrderID
Field.Description: The new Order ID of the replacement order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new order price. Use the Price scale from the series mapping index.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The new order quantity in contracts.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order (Buy/Sell).

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: CustIndicator
Field.Description: Capacity of the new order.

Message.Name: Options Imbalance Message
Message.Description: Published every 5 seconds, during opening and re-opening auctions to update price and volume information.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series for all products within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: PairedQty
Field.Description: The number of contracts paired off at the Indicative Match Price.

Field.Name: TotalImbalanceQty
Field.Description: The total imbalance quantity at the Indicative Match Price.

Field.Name: MarketImbalanceQty
Field.Description: The total market order imbalance quantity at the Indicative Match Price.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for Future use

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Type of Auction.

Field.Name: ImbalanceSide
Field.Description: The side of the TotalImbalanceQty.

Field.Name: ContinuousBookClearingPrice
Field.Description: The price at which all interest on the book can trade, including auction and imbalance offset interest, and disregarding auction collars.

Field.Name: AuctionInterestClearingPrice
Field.Description: The price at which all eligible auction-only interest would trade, subject to auction collars.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for Future use.

Field.Name: IndicativeMatchPrice
Field.Description: The price at which the highest number of contracts would trade, subject to auction collars.

Field.Name: Upper Collar
Field.Description: Legal width bid for option

Field.Name: Lower Collar
Field.Description: Legal width offer for option

Field.Name: AuctionStatus
Field.Description: Indicates the Auction Status.

Message.Name: Options Add Order Refresh Message
Message.Description: Sent as part of a refresh response for every order currently resting on the book.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to this order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The order price. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The order quantity in contracts.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order (Buy/sell). Valid values: B - Buy, S - Sell

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: The participant's firm ID (always space). ' ' - (space or 0x20)

Field.Name: Reserved

Field.Name: CustIndicator

Message.Name: Options Series RFQ Message
Message.Description: Published for outright series. Generated by the matching engine to solicit interest in an auction or order.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series for all products within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: RFQ Side
Field.Description: Side of the RFQ.

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: Order Type of CUBE/BOLD/COA

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: Customer or Firm capacity specified with the order. Only valid for BOLD (Type = B).

Field.Name: Total quantity
Field.Description: Total quantity

Field.Name: Working Price
Field.Description: RFQ Price

Field.Name: Participant
Field.Description: OCC Number for the Clearing firm specified with the order. '0' - (0x00) indicates OCC Number was not specified. Only valid for BOLD (Type = B).

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Auction ID for CUBE/COA

Field.Name: RFQ Status
Field.Description: Status field for CUBE/COA

Message.Name: Options Outright Series Summary Message
Message.Description: Published every 60 seconds on a separate multicast channel. Provides high, low, open, close and total volume per series.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: HighPrice
Field.Description: The Highest price of the series for the day. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: LowPrice
Field.Description: The Lowest price of the series for the day. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Open
Field.Description: The First price of the series for the day. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Close
Field.Description: The Last price of the series for the day. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: TotalVolume
Field.Description: The cumulative volume for the series throughout the day.
